title: Nushell failed: Can't run alias directly. Unwrap it first.
verification_plan: Build nushell from source (`cargo build`). Create an alias `alias "from jsonc" = from json`, then attempt to use it in a pipeline like `open deno.jsonc`. Confirm the error "Can't run alias directly. Unwrap it first." appears. Fix the alias resolution in the evaluator to forward aliases to their underlying commands in pipeline context. Run `cargo test` to verify no regressions in command resolution.

history.note: Triaged from 72-hour window. Bug: defining an alias that wraps another command and then using it in a pipeline produces a fatal error 'Can't run alias directly. Unwrap it first.' instead of executing the underlying command. Affects the alias resolution/evaluation path in nushell. Requires investigation in the evaluator or parser.
